messages.subject: routine-update of BioConductor data packages -> d/watch
messages.subject_clean: routine-update of BioConductor data packages -> d/watch
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/html/tximportData.html

r-bioc-tximportdata has a different home page than the more algorithmic packages and thus needs a different d/watch template.
Routine-update should anticipate that but happily applies the wrong one. And then does not find the updated version of the package.
I have reverted routine-update's change to d/watch as a quick hack.

Someone of yours certainly has this more less under their fingers, I am confident :)

Cheers,
Steffen

messages.body_plain:
Le Sun, Aug 02, 2026 at 03:52:59PM +0000, Steffen Möller a écrit :
> https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/html/tximportData.html
> r-bioc-tximportdata has a different home page than the more algorithmic
> packages and thus needs a different d/watch template.

Hi Steffen,

you are right; sorry for not catching it up earlier.

I will fix the uscan templates but in the meantime you need to add the
following line to experiment data packages (and something similar
for annotation packages).

    Download-Url-Mangle: s%.*/src/contrib/%https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/src/contrib/%

I have added the following line to routine-update as a transiennt fix.

    grep -q ExperimentData DESCRIPTION && echo 'Downloadurlmangle: s%.*/src/contrib/%https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/src/contrib/%' >> debian/watch

Have a nice day,

Charles

--
